question: Can a frozen semi-dense local correspondence model provide absolute same-door support and exact NONE assignments on fresh SceneNN targets under severe geometry-selected viewpoint changes?

independent_motivation.source_inference: EfficientLoFTR uses detector-free semi-dense mutual-nearest correspondences and is designed for large viewpoint changes and texture-poor images. Its official implementation warns of an outdoor-training domain gap indoors, so fresh SceneNN is a direct falsification test, not presumed authority.

source_selector.inventory: Previously materialized SceneNN XML labels plus official HTTP HEAD metadata only; no selected PLY, trajectory, RGB, depth, or model score opened before admission.
source_selector.target_label: normalized lowercase text must match door followed by zero or more digits
source_selector.candidate_rule: Every unconsumed scene with at least one qualifying door and an official ONI Content-Length; choose the four smallest ONI payloads, tie by scene ID; choose the lowest numeric door instance in each selected scene.

provider.name: SceneNN
provider.sensor: Asus Xtion PRO consumer RGB-D camera
provider.license_boundary: Educational and research use; raw SceneNN payloads remain local and are not redistributed.

pre_rgb_selector.pair_ranking: maximum camera-centre baseline, then minimum visible target pixels, minimum visibility ratio, earlier frames

renderer.near_plane_face_rule: reject unless every vertex is beyond near plane
renderer.visibility_rule: target depth finite and no farther than full-scene depth plus 0.005 m

pre_rgb_selector.failure_semantics: If any selected target lacks a qualifying pair, stop NOT_EVALUABLE without substituting a scene or changing geometry rules.

matcher.input: expand the evaluator-visible target-mask tight box by 1.25 about its centre, clamp, crop raw RGB without masking, then use the frozen 480x640 grayscale processor
matcher.absolute_support: a pair is supported only if match count and RANSAC inlier gates both pass and a finite homography exists
matcher.zero_assignment: strict reciprocal maximum by homography inlier count among supported pairs; unsupported pairs are NONE
matcher.adaptation: none; CPU inference; no threshold or score fitting

baseline.model: same frozen local DINOv2-S used by the consumed FFA experiment
baseline.descriptor: L2-normalized mean of final patch tokens on the identical raw context crop
baseline.assignment: strict reciprocal cosine with no absolute support
baseline.purpose: paired fresh-cohort comparison only; it has no NONE authority

forbidden_after_rgb_access: change scenes, target instances, selected frames, crop expansion, model, processor, match threshold, match/inlier minimum, RANSAC tolerance, score, reciprocity, scenarios, or decision gate
drop a target or failed scenario
fit a threshold or model on the fresh results
claim_boundary: A pass is fresh SceneNN Development evidence that truth-cropped local visual correspondences can support same-door/NONE decisions across severe selected views. It remains same-provider, evaluator-mask-conditioned indoor RGB, not raw-phone detection, aperture, named entrance, ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, user benefit, deployment, or safety evidence.
